# CodexMeter 0.1.3
- Replaces vague history-quality warnings with concrete refresh results and update timestamps. - Rotates the refresh control once per refresh and animates changed totals without continuous motion. - Respects the macOS Reduce Motion accessibility setting. - Adds installation through the public `HechoLP/homebrew-tap` personal Tap.
This build is ad-hoc signed and is not notarized by Apple. Homebrew verifies the exact published ZIP with SHA-256, but the personal Tap does not make the app Apple-trusted.
## Homebrew
```bash brew install --cask HechoLP/tap/codexmeter xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
The `xattr` command removes macOS download quarantine from `CodexMeter.app` only. Run it only after the Homebrew installation completes from `HechoLP/tap/codexmeter`.
## Direct download
Download `CodexMeter-0.1.3.dmg` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` from the official public release into the same folder. Do not continue unless the checksum command prints `OK`.
```bash cd ~/Downloads grep ' CodexMeter-0.1.3.dmg$' SHA256SUMS.txt | shasum -a 256 -c - open CodexMeter-0.1.3.dmg ```
Copy `CodexMeter.app` from the DMG to `Applications`, then remove quarantine from that app and launch it:
```bash xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
